The '''Cordel Cove Hostel''' was located in [[Cordel Cove]] on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. Rooms at the hostel cost over four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a night, and there were several [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] attached to the hostel.<ref name="BSS" />
